headline: Tatu Helander climbs 325 places to 76th on ARC-2

sections.text: Tatu Helander climbed 325 places in the past day, from 401st to 76th, reaching a score of 36.39 after a 4.58 gain.
The jump carries Helander into the top 100 in a field of 3,106 teams.
